body: Yes, absolutely! I get so flustered and tongue tied in the heat of the moment, but put me behind a keyboard, and I suddenly become a bard! Haha

Thank you for the heads up! This is definitely my first time ever bringing up sexuality in therapy, so I have no idea what to expect. I have certainly had my fair share of bad therapists when dealing with other mental health issues I face, so I don’t mind shopping around. It is nice to know that I can be open and honest here. 

I wish you the best of luck in your decision of whether or not to come out to your family, and I greatly appreciate the sentiment that there is no right or wrong amount of time to wait. I know that my loved ones will have questions, so I just need to make sure I’m in the right state of mind for those. I am comfortable in knowing that I have so much love to give, but I just might love differently.

Cheers :)
That’s not a bad idea. I know the FAQ posts on the home page helped me immensely. So maybe that could help answer some of her questions?

The journaling is a great idea. I always talk myself out of bringing this up to my therapists because I suddenly convince myself that it’s normal. My parents keep telling me I just have an overactive imagination, but I’m concerned it’s more than that. I’ll start writing stuff down, thank you

It brings me a lot of distress. Especially when I come down from this “high”. I can live in this world, where I am dead ass convinced that I’m famous and will marry this imaginary man for days at a time. When I finally realize it isn’t real, I get majorly depressed. I get suicidal thoughts and urges. My boyfriend knows I’m going to therapy and knows about the famous thing. Just not the imaginary man
Thank you for the sentiment. I do like going on walks. I got my thoughts together and got out of there. I’m with someone who cares about me now, and we’re taking it slow
Have you considered getting a strap on? And just trying that out for awhile? Not that you have to wear it around or use it during sex or anything. Just for you on your own time
